purpose: Behavior guards for the candidate-page repairs (D14, GUARD-001). Forbidden guards are a broad match minus named exceptions, so surviving old text fails them (D26-E, SCOPE-001); required guards prove the repair text is present. These are candidate registry assertions, carried to the release-qualification Modification for the candidate registry.
semantics: A unit is a line, or a sentence within a line (split after . ! or ?). A unit matches when every `all` pattern matches it and no `except` pattern does. A forbidden guard passes at 0 matching units; a required guard passes at exactly `expect` matching units per prompt. Only counts are reported (D22).
fixture_rule: Fixtures are synthetic text, not prompt bodies. Each `pass` fixture must satisfy the guard and each `fail` fixture must violate it; a guard whose fail fixture passes has never fired (GUARD-001).
